summary: Backend smoke + functional tests for SSH Bastion Central MVP. Executed 33 checks across auth (JWT Bearer), devices CRUD + ping + ping-all, agents CRUD + install-script, ssh-key (get/generate/put), scripts CRUD, batch execute (resilient with fake hosts), sessions, stats, admin-only routes with operator 403 check, and WebSocket terminal (valid+invalid device_id, token auth). All checks passed. Fake seed hosts fail SSH gracefully via error messages, no 500s observed.
passed: POST /api/devices/{id}/ping returns 200 on fake host (offline, no 500)
POST /api/ssh-key/generate creates RSA pair; subsequent GET has_key=true
GET /api/scripts returns >=3 seed; POST + DELETE work
POST /api/batch/execute returns {results:[...]} with ok=false + error for offline devices, no 500
GET /api/sessions returns list (includes batch session logged after batch execute)
GET /api/users admin -> 200; operator -> 403; POST /api/agents as operator -> 403; POST /api/ssh-key/generate as operator -> 403
WS /api/ws/terminal/{invalid_id}?token=... -> type=error msg + close, no server crash
WS /api/ws/terminal/{valid_id}?token=... -> first frame type=status, then type=error when SSH fails on fake host (server stays up)
